222-527-3499-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2023-4518-5223-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

280-4050-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

4636-4772-5770-7824.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

826-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
826-4997-7414.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Pensive Professor to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

757-2930-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

661-1976-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Etherium Sculptor. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2829-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1394-2060-4050-7038-7061.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Solid Ground.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Solid Ground.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

5170-5256-6132-7286.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

997-4605-4681-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4934-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
4934-5078-5901.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

104-1545-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1545-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2866-4708-4986-6797.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

969-1402-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6564.description:
Cast Hildibrand either from your hand, from exile, or from the command zone by paying {1}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hildibrand, adding {C}{C}.
When Hildibrand triggers, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Hildibrand trigger, allowing you to cast it from your graveyard as an Adventure until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gentlemen's Rise from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and exiling Gentlemen's Rise with the ability to cast it as Hildibrand later.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
When the Zombie dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

3719-5231-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-5231-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping four creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out, adding {R}.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

856-4321-5231-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5231-5632.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1429-2511-4452-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2511-4452-5402.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-3097-3490-4616.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2523-2921-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat from step 2.

238-997-1365-1477.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-997-1365-1477.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

731-790-1972.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
731-790-1972.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Nekusar triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

628-914-4050-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
Dockside Extortionist does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-914-4050-4153.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {W}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving all +1/+1 counters from Dockside Extortionist onto another permanent you control.
Repeat.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

813-1181-3125.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
813-1181-3125.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice a creature and return Scholar of the Ages and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sacrifice and Victimize to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

914-1651-3632.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1651-3632.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Erratic Portal.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control six of more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite untapped Treasure tokens as opposed to infinite tapped Treasure tokens.

1594-2275-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

970-1339-1656-4050.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Asmodeus' first ability by paying {B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw seven cards.
The Locust God triggers seven times, creating seven 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Insects, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2493-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk to your hand.
Repeat.
